description: a representative sample of DocBook 5.2 block-shaped elements found missing from is_block_element by a full audit against the format's element index (beyond the four families named by the original audit — glossentry/indexentry/refnamediv/entrytbl, each with their own dedicated fixture): <simplelist>, <refsection> (the generic recursive refentry subsection, sibling of refsect1/2/3), <productionset>/<production> (EBNF grammar). Each must classify as a raw-preserved div, not fall through the catch-all as an inline span
